name: Doom
description: Curses an enemy within %cast_range% tiles, silencing it and dealing %base_dmg% damage per turn, escalating by %dmg_increase% each turn.
details: The curse has no duration - it lifts only once the cursed unit claims a kill of its own.

upgrade.summary: Enemies beside the cursed unit take %splash_damage:pct%% of the damage as well.
details: The curse has no duration - it lifts only once the cursed unit claims a kill of its own.
Every tick spills %splash_damage:pct%% onto each enemy adjacent to the cursed unit, so the longer it runs the worse standing near them gets.
